bottom_circular_scorecards.title: Document Verification Score
bottom_circular_scorecards.plagiarism_gauge: Circular SVG progress ring with animated stroke and percentage counter
bottom_circular_scorecards.ai_detector_gauge: Circular SVG progress ring with colored risk index (Human vs AI)

interactive_word_replacement_modal.type: Centered Popup Modal / Backdrop Blur Dialog
interactive_word_replacement_modal.trigger: User clicks any highlighted word in the rephrased output pane
features: Displays target word original context vs current replacement
Grid of alternative synonym/antonym/rhyme options with confidence scores
Acoustic/Syllable breakdown tag for selected word
interactive_word_replacement_modal.modal_style: fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-md p-4 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95

key_components.name: Header & Top Bar
key_components.description: Sticky top bar with branding, usage quota badge (e.g., '1,250 words remaining for Guest'), Theme switcher, Saved history drawer button, and Auth button (Login/Signup modal).

key_components.name: Center Curved Square Rephrase Workspace
key_components.description: Large rounded-3xl container housing header (mode dropdown), split pane (input textarea vs highlighted output pane), and footer (word count comparison & AI / Plagiarism check action buttons).

key_components.name: Parts-of-Speech Left Menu
key_components.description: Real-time analyzer extracting Nouns, Verbs, Adjectives, Adverbs, Prepositions from user input with item counts, click-to-highlight filter badges.

key_components.name: Circular Score Card Widget
key_components.description: Dual radial ring gauges at the bottom of the left sidebar rendering real-time Plagiarism % score and AI Detection % risk index with color status (Safe / Medium / High).

key_components.name: Word Replacement Modal
key_components.description: Pop-up overlay centered on screen triggered when clicking highlighted changes in the output pane, letting users select alternate synonyms or custom terms.

key_components.name: AI & Plagiarism Detailed Report Dialog
key_components.description: Full overlay modal showing line-by-line sentence risk breakdown, source matching, and AI confidence heatmaps when user clicks 'Check AI Level' or 'Check Plagiarism Level'.

key_components.name: History & Presets Drawer
key_components.description: Slide-over drawer for past rephrased documents, sample templates (Academic Essay, Marketing Pitch, Story Paragraph, Resume Summary), and export options (DOCX, PDF, Copy).

instructions_to_main_agent: Always set body font-family to 'EB Garamond', serif across light and dark themes.
Ensure dark mode is fully functional using Tailwind 'dark' class on document root with smooth transitions.
Implement the center container as a big curved edges square block (rounded-3xl or rounded-2xl) with clean split-pane grid.
Header of the center block MUST have a dropdown on the right for rephrase modes: Synonym, Antonym, Rhyme, Syllable Flipped, Academic, Conversational.
Footer of the center block MUST show input word count vs output word count on the left, and 2 distinct action buttons on the right: 'Check AI Level' and 'Check Plagiarism Level'.
Right output pane MUST render rephrased text with clickable highlighted spans (badge/pill style with amber/emerald glow).
Clicking any highlighted word MUST open a centered pop-up modal with synonym replacement options and an 'Apply' button.
Left menu section MUST parse user input text and present a parts-of-speech breakdown (Nouns, Verbs, Adjectives, Adverbs, Prepositions).
Bottom of the left menu MUST feature dual circular scorecards (Plagiarism % and AI Detector %) with animated SVG rings.
Provide rich interactive state (sample text button, paste, copy, clear, toast alerts via sonner, auth state modal).
Ensure ALL interactive elements include explicit data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Lucide or Phosphor React icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
